id: title:danielcarletti:let a fan out parent scan report and resume a position

review.posthog_relevance: Adds checkpointing and position-tracking metadata to warehouse parent page scans, potentially enabling resumable ingestion and recovery for warehouse connector workflows.
review.reason: Adds ScanPosition and ParentPage classes with position_after and matches, P1.F2.H1. P1.F2.H3 records fingerprint in return. P1.F2.H5 adds documentation and a parameter. P1.F2.H6 replaces row iteration and page yielding with fragment-based iteration, adding support for resuming and checkpointing.
review.uncertainty: The implementation demonstrates bounded capability and correctness improvements, but the actual benefit of checkpointing and resuming is not demonstrated by the code, and the connection to PostHog is not established.
